messages:
erin_sales: Heads-up: we need to finalize the handback for Orion POC. Proposed window Mon 07:00 PT. Checklist: revoke hosted keys, drain+terminate dedicated pool dp-orion, remove VPC peering, export logs, and confirm retention/attestation. Who can own what?

chris_ops: I can own pool and VPC. My plan: set pool to noop, drain with 5m grace, then terminate. Commands: 
```bash
rctl pool update dp-orion --mode noop
rctl pool drain dp-orion --grace 300 --wait
rctl pool terminate dp-orion --reason "poc-handback"
```
I'll export flow logs first and mute alerts.

mike_sre: I'll handle log export and S3 upload. Will sync control plane + inference logs to a locked bucket and post the link before any revocation: 
```bash
aws s3 sync /var/log/orion s3://orion-poc-exports/1932456789 --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
I expect upload done T-15.

tara_security: I'll do key revocation, scheduled at T+5 to ensure logs show recent usage. Revocation API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"orion-poc","scope":"all","reason":"handback"}'
```
I'll attach the revocation audit JSON. Also recommend rotating any long-lived service principals.

nina_billing: Billing note: on-demand stops at termination; reserved capacity would still bill. This POC was on on-demand so charges stop. I'll produce a final usage statement after termination.

sara_legal: Per SLA, default retention is 90 days for customer data. If Orion signs waiver we can delete earlier and provide an attestation. I'll draft attestation language and post it here for signature.

erin_sales: Owners confirmed: chris_ops = pool+vpc, mike_sre = logs, tara_security = keys, nina_billing = billing, sara_legal = attestation. Mon 07:00 PT pending S3 link. Please react with :white_check_mark: if available.

chris_ops: :white_check_mark: I'll wait for the S3 link and then start T0.

mike_sre: :white_check_mark: Upload scheduled T-15, will post link.

tara_security: :white_check_mark: Revocation scheduled T+5 after link posted.

sara_legal: :white_check_mark: Drafting attestation now.

ops-bot: Ticket POC-43902 created and runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-sunset. Will post completion summary and artifacts on close.

erin_sales: Thanks everyone. After completion, please attach: S3 export link, revocation audit, termination timestamp, and signed attestation (or waiver).
